prompt: Janet has recently set up Squid as a caching proxy for her organization. She needs to specify which networks are allowed to access the Squid service. Which configuration directive in the Squid configuration file should Janet modify to achieve this?
explanation: An `acl` with the `src` type matches client source IP addresses or networks; it defines which networks are permitted to use the Squid service when paired with an `http_access` rule.
